title: REQ · Zod schemas for objects, scenes and worlds
summary: Object and world zod schemas with non-throwing parser
description: Context: no runtime schema exists for object content. Desired behavior: objectSchema covers id, name, description, asset, position, scale, layer, interactionBounds, actions, visibleWhen conditions and persistentState; scene and world schemas wrap it. Expected result: parseWorldContent returns typed data or path-named errors. Why: validated content for AI authoring.
acceptance_criteria: Given a valid object with all fields, when parsed, then ok is true
Given an object with layer 'sky', when parsed, then errors include path ending in layer
Given an object without position, when parsed, then errors include path ending in position
Given scale omitted, when parsed, then scale defaults to 1
technical_constraints: Layers: background, furniture, objects, characters, effects, ui
Action ids: inspect, push, search, leave
